catalog.method: GET deep3.txt (User-Agent DeepTune-VPN); drop byte at index 3; Base64(salt[0:16] || nonce[16:28] || ciphertext[28:]); Argon2id t=3 m=8192KiB p=1 keyLen=32 + AES-256-GCM, AAD=salt; same construction for fields
catalog.notes: Live re-run 2026-11-17: v3.12 (delivered sample was v3.11, 101 networks); only difference is the version + 1 new network; all 6 servers field-identical. 12 field values do not fully open with either password (SlowDNSHost x3, SlowDNSKey x6, V2rayUUID x3: first layer opens to inner base64, second layer fails; delivered as-is). Coordinator 2026-11-17: expanded SERVER_FIELDS (+ServerIPHost, UDP_obfs, UDP_user, H2pass) and NETWORK_FIELDS (+BugDNS) after verifying live that all 48 decrypt with the existing passwords (ServerIPHost -> hostname e.g. sm.mtmtun.com; BugDNS -> 8.8.8.8; UDP_obfs/UDP_user/H2pass -> one Base64 token layer, legitimate plaintext for keys); re-run v3.12 verified byte-identical except the 5 newly-decrypted fields. Full download+decrypt took ~17.6 s (catalog budget 120 s).

dependencies: cryptography (AES-256-GCM; NOT in the repo root requirements.txt yet — must be added before the worker can import these scripts)

files.method: configfile.json (Base64 envelope, field password), deep3.txt (drop byte 3, file password), or already-decrypted JSON (decrypts remaining encrypted fields). No proprietary file extension and no proprietary link scheme.
files.notes: Bundled configfile.json v1.01 opens: 9 servers, 111 networks. Standard vless/vmess/trojan/ss links are handled by existing SP-DECODE methods, not this script.

name: DeepTune-VPN
